items.title: Aptiv Q3 Earnings Surpass Estimates Amid Non-Auto Growth
items.summary: APTV beats Q3 2026 earnings and revenue estimates, driven by Engineered Components growth, but margin pressures and a cautious 2027 outlook cloud results.

items.title: BR's Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Recurring Revenue Growth
items.summary: Broadridge beats fiscal Q1'27 earnings & revenue estimates as recurring revenues rise 11%. Declining margins and event-driven revenues weigh on results.

items.title: Her Mother Has Dementia. She Can Freeze Her Mother’s Credit at All Three Bureaus, for Free, Before a Scammer Opens an Account in Her Name
items.summary: A stranger only needs one phone call and a Social Security number to open credit accounts in a confused parent's name, but federal law gives caregivers a specific legal tool to shut that door before it opens.

items.title: Her Father Died in March. Until She Tells the Credit Bureaus and Social Security, His Name Is an Open Door for Identity Thieves
items.summary: A death certificate closes a chapter, but it does not close a credit file, a tax account, or a Social Security number. Thieves know exactly how long that window stays open, and the clock started in March.

items.title: Millions of Americans could be owed up to $280 from a major credit bureau. Here’s who qualifies
items.summary: Equifax has agreed to a $100 million class action settlement involving inaccurate credit information. Eligible consumers have until December 28 to file a claim.

items.title: Trane Technologies' Q3 Earnings Beat on Strong Commercial HVAC Demand
items.summary: TT delivers strong Q3 2026 earnings as robust HVAC demand fuels revenue growth and record backlog, prompting a higher full-year revenue outlook.

items.title: Eni and Burlington Stores have been highlighted as Zacks Bull and Bear of the Day
items.summary: Eni's rising earnings estimates and attractive valuation bolster its bullish outlook, while Burlington Stores faces falling profit forecasts, slowing sales and mounting downside risks.
